resources.string: This permanently deletes your account, every memory and every photo, from this device and from the cloud. This can\'t be undone.
You need to be online to delete your account. Nothing was deleted.
Couldn\'t delete your account. Nothing was deleted. Please try again.
Your memories are personal. Here is exactly what the app keeps and who can see it.
Your email address, and for each memory: the item, where it is, an optional note, category and photo, whether it\'s a favorite, and when it was saved or changed.
On this phone, so the app works offline, and in your private account in our cloud database, so nothing is lost if you change phones. Data is encrypted in transit.
Only you. Access rules in the database only allow your account to read or change your memories. We don\'t sell your memories and don\'t use analytics. Your memories are never shared with advertisers.
Photos you choose are resized, and their hidden metadata, such as GPS location and camera details, is removed before anything is saved or uploaded.
The microphone is used only while you tap Speak, through your phone\'s speech recognition service. Recordings are not stored by this app.

The app is free and shows at most three full-screen ads a day, only after you finish something, never while you search or type. Ads are provided by Google AdMob, which may use your device\'s advertising ID and approximate location to choose ads. Where the law requires it, you\'re asked for consent first and can change your choice in Settings › Ad privacy choices. Your memories and photos are never shared with Google for ads.
Delete a memory at any time. Settings › Delete account permanently removes your account, every memory and every photo.
